description: Connects Codex sessions in this project to TarikOS memory, flush, and house rules. SessionEnd and PreCompact summaries are written by the central vault runtime; this project contains no duplicate memory implementation. The central SessionStart already injects Kurallar.md; registering the project-local brain-rules hook as well would duplicate the rules. Claude uses .claude/settings.json -> SessionStart -> brain-rules.sh. Commands use ABSOLUTE vault paths because Codex defines neither CODEX_PROJECT_DIR nor CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. TRUST GATE: Codex asks for approval once when it first sees this file, and an UNAPPROVED HOOK IS SILENTLY SKIPPED (the screen still says 'Completed'); do not assume it is running without approval. GENERATED FILE - edit by running: python D:/TarikOS/.claude/scripts/render_codex_hooks.py --project <project-directory>
